newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania c.bank reserves rise in December 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania c.bank reserves rise in December 1996.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday that its assets rose in December last year to 3.8 billion litas from 3.68 billion litas.
The bank said in a statement that 87.7 percent of its assets were foreign, which rose by 3.7 percent to 3.34 billion litas.
The bank said that convertible currencies made up 91.1 percent of foreign assets. The amount of convertible currency held by the bank rose by 4.8 percent in December.
The bank said it had purchased more U.S. dollars than it sold during the month.
The bank's official reserves rose during December to $834.2 million from $804.1 million.
The statement also said that during December the central bank put into circultion 97.1 million litas for a total of 1.998 billion litas in circultaion.
